title: 第一万一百一十五章 各自心动第一万一百一十四章 无之同类
content_zh:
在说完这句话后，器灵的口中，接着又发出了一连串外人根本无法听懂的古怪音节。
而随着这些音节的响起，器灵的体内，蓦然升腾起了一种透明的火焰，将他整个人包裹了起来。
不仅仅是他，就连再次被姬空凡牢牢握在掌心中的他的本体，那块法器的碎片之上，同样有着透明火焰升腾。
“唔！”
火焰沿着碎片，直接蔓延到了姬空凡的手掌之上，让他的口中发出了一声闷哼。
虽然姬空凡并不知道，这火焰到底是什么火，但他不难推测的出来，这必然是来自于器灵最后的反击！
而这反而让姬空凡的心中稍稍安定了下来。
这场和器灵间的最后大战，姬空凡其实并没有丝毫的胜算。
原因很简单。
不管是姬空凡自己，还是姜云，他们对器灵的了解实在太少。
而器灵对他们，却是非常的了解，甚至可以说是看着他们诞生，看着他们一路成长至今！
虽然姬空凡也有些倚仗，但相对于器灵来说，却是少的太多了。
而事实也证明，器灵的手段和后手，真的是层出不穷，让人防不胜防！
从开始的无相，到无有之相的神通，再到太一和千朔等人之死，直至最后召唤出古寒节等古之子民。
如果仅凭姬空凡一人，哪怕他是造化师，也早就已经被器灵给炼制成了一件法器，根本不可能坚持到现在。
而之所以姬空凡始终没有动用那柄为姜云炼制的刀，就是因为那是他最后的倚仗。
但这倚仗，他很清楚，只有一次出手的机会，所以他一直在等，等器灵拿出所有的手段。
好在姜云的及时出现，又成功的强行从器灵的手中抢回了古寒节等人一半的力量，这才让姬空凡找到了机会，将刀扔给了姜云。
姜云也没有让姬空凡失望。
这惊艳的一刀，成功劈开了天地，劈碎了器灵的所有抵抗。

现在，器灵终于动用了他的本体，说明他的确已经是黔驴技穷了。
因此，姬空凡非但没有松开碎片，反而将其握的更紧！
连归元之力都没有击垮自己，这区区的透明之火，更烧不死自己。
不过，器灵显然没有在意姬空凡的想法。
火焰灼烧之下，器灵的身体之上，开始有着一道道的无之痕浮现而出。
这些无之痕，化作了一颗颗灰白色的光点，环绕在器灵的身体四周，让他的身体也是快速的变得透明起来。
仅仅几息之后，器灵的身体就已经完全消失。
如果有之地的人看到这一幕，一定认为，器灵这是被自身体内升起的火焰给灼烧成了虚无。
但实际上，器灵本就是来自于无之地。
他和无相一样，本身都是一种虚无的存在。
只不过，作为器灵，他无需像无相那样，只能通过寄生而活，而是可以依托在自己的本体之上。
而此时此刻，他只是恢复到了自己的本源状态，将他在有之地内获得的一起，当做燃料，以一种类似于献祭的方式，化作的一道传讯，去通知他的同类。
那些无之痕燃烧后所化作的灰白光点，并没有和器灵一起消散。
而是在他消失的位置飞速旋转了几圈之后，突然就冲天而起，顺着姜云刚刚劈开的那道裂缝，冲了出去。
天地之外，始终聚集在这里的岳钧等强者，一直牢牢关注着被墟鱼环绕的区域。
虽然即便是那位造化师，都无法真正看到区域内的情况，但他们可以根据劫云的状态，去推测出里面的大致状况。
器灵再次封锁这方天地之后，汇聚在上方的劫云，立刻就开始了消散，那些从四面八方而来的各种太初之力，也是四散离开。
唯有归元之力仍然存在，但失去了其他太初之力，归元之力自然也是随之减弱。
这让正凝神关注着那片区域的岳钧等人的脸上，不禁都是露出了疑惑之色。
content_en:
After saying this, Qi Ling's mouth then uttered a series of strange syllables that outsiders could not understand at all.
As these syllables sounded, a transparent flame suddenly rose up in Qi Ling's body, enveloping his entire body.
Not only him, but also his body, which was firmly held in Ji Kongfan's palm again, and the fragments of the magic weapon, there were also transparent flames rising.
"Ugh!"
The flames spread directly along the fragments to Ji Kongfan's palm, causing him to groan.
Although Ji Kongfan didn't know what kind of fire this flame was, it was not difficult for him to deduce that it must be the final counterattack from the weapon spirit!
But this made Ji Kongfan's heart settle down a little.
In this final battle with the weapon spirit, Ji Kongfan actually had no chance of winning.
The reason is simple.
Whether it is Ji Kongfan himself or Jiang Yun, they know too little about weapon spirits.
But the weapon spirit knows them very well. It can even be said that he has watched them be born and watched them grow up to this day!
Although Ji Kongfan also relies on some, but compared to the weapon spirit, it is much less.
And facts have also proved that the methods and back-ups of the weapon spirit are really endless, making it difficult for people to guard against!
From the beginning of no form, to the supernatural power of no form, to the death of Taiyi, Qian Shuo and others, until finally summoning the ancient people such as Gu Hanjie.
If Ji Kongfan was alone, even if he was a master of creation, he would have been refined into a magic weapon by the weapon spirit long ago, and it would be impossible for him to persist until now.
And the reason why Ji Kongfan never used the sword he refined for Jiang Yun was because it was his last resort.
But relying on it, he knew very well that there was only one chance to take action, so he kept waiting for the weapon spirit to use all its means.
Fortunately, Jiang Yun appeared in time and successfully snatched half of the power of Gu Hanjie and others from the hands of the weapon spirit. Only then did Ji Kongfan find the opportunity and throw the knife to Jiang Yun.
Jiang Yun did not disappoint Ji Kongfan.
This amazing sword successfully split the heaven and the earth and shattered all the resistance of the weapon spirit.
Now, Qi Ling has finally used his true body, which shows that he is indeed at the end of his rope.
Therefore, instead of letting go of the fragment, Ji Kongfan held it tighter!
Not even the power of returning to the origin could defeat him, and this mere transparent fire couldn't even burn him to death.
However, Qi Ling obviously didn't care about Ji Kongfan's thoughts.
Under the burning flames, traces of traces began to appear on the body of the weapon spirit.
These traces turned into gray-white light spots, surrounding the body of the weapon spirit, making his body quickly become transparent.
After just a few breaths, the body of the weapon spirit completely disappeared.
If someone from somewhere saw this scene, they would definitely think that the weapon spirit was burned into nothingness by the flames rising from within its own body.
But in fact, the weapon spirit comes from nowhere.
Like Wuxiang, he is an existence of nothingness.
However, as a tool spirit, he does not need to live through parasitism like Wuxiang, but can rely on his own body.
At this moment, he just returned to his original state, using the things he obtained in the land of existence as fuel, in a way similar to sacrifice, turned into a message to inform his kind.
The gray-white light spots turned into by the burning of Wu Zhihui did not dissipate together with the weapon spirit.
Instead, after a few rapid rotations at the place where he disappeared, he suddenly rose into the sky and rushed out along the crack that Jiang Yun had just opened.
Outside the world, Yue Jun and other powerful men who have always gathered here have been keeping a close eye on the area surrounded by fish.
Although even the good fortune master cannot really see the situation in the area,They can deduce the general situation inside based on the state of the robbery cloud.
After the weapon spirit sealed the world again, the calamity clouds gathering above immediately began to dissipate, and the various powers of the beginning from all directions also scattered and left.
Only the power of Guiyuan still exists, but without the other powers of Taichu, the power of Guiyuan will naturally weaken.
This made Yue Jun and others who were paying close attention to that area couldn't help but have doubts on their faces.
